verdict.rationale: RudderStack documents an Audiences feature that builds audiences on warehouse sources and syncs or activates them to downstream tools, with warehouse activation pipelines reaching over 200 SaaS tools. Nothing shows the sync is continuous or that members enter and exit in near-real-time. The 'near real-time' claim applies only to viewing Live Events, which is a different feature and earns no credit here. Missing for 10: evidence of continuous or streaming audience sync, near-real-time membership entry/exit, named ad-platform and engagement-tool destinations for audiences, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a marketer, audiences sync to ad platforms and engagement tools continuously, with membership entering and exiting in near-real-time

citations.quote: Build audiences and sync them to your downstream tools.
Build audiences on warehouse sources and activate them downstream
Quickly set up and monitor pipelines from your warehouse or data lake directly to over 200 SaaS tools.
